title: PitchCraft Deck DSL
description: Canonical intermediate representation. Content is separated from presentation rendering so a deck stays portable across HTML, PPTX, PDF and image renderers. Validate with scripts/validate_deck.py (stdlib-only) or any JSON Schema tooling.

desired_action.description: What the audience should do after.

style.description: e.g. premium editorial consulting, startup strategy deck.

language.description: BCP-47 tag, e.g. en, th, th-EN-mixed.

source_provenance.description: Where deck sources live, e.g. sources-map.json.

structure.description: Named narrative spine, e.g. Problem -> Insight -> Evidence -> Solution -> Action.

arc.description: One entry per slide: the beat it plays in the story.
